6-pd-6.prompt: Which operation is mainly used to write a 'has no …' query in relational algebra?

6-pd-7.prompt: Explain which relational algebra operations correspond to SQL's NOT EXISTS, EXISTS AND EXISTS, UNION and NOT EXISTS (EXCEPT).
6-pd-7.answer: 'Has no …' (NOT EXISTS / NOT IN) → difference −. 'A and also B' (EXISTS AND EXISTS / INTERSECT) → intersection ∩. 'A or B' (UNION) → union ∪. 'All …' (NOT EXISTS + EXCEPT) → division ÷.
